headline: Richard Csaky vaults from 658th into ARC-2 gold

sections.text: Richard Csaky gained 27.36 points to reach 58.33, climbing from 658th to 9th on ARC-AGI-2.
The surge puts Csaky inside the 15 public gold places, where the current cutoff is 48.33. The standings remain provisional.
